salary_details.details: The consolidated professional fee is Rs. 16,000 per month (Rupees Sixteen Thousand only). The Kalimpong and Krishnanagar notices add that the amount is subject to applicable statutory deductions. The engagement is contractual, and the contract is for 01 (one) year. Kalimpong and Krishnanagar state that renewal is subject to satisfactory performance. All notices state that no claim for regularisation will be entertained.

selection_process: Selection is through a Driving Test and Interview of 40 marks in total. Shortlisted candidates with valid applications are called for both stages
and a merit list is prepared on the marks obtained.

Provisionally selected candidates must undergo a Medical Fitness Test as directed by the competent authority. The selected candidate must submit a Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) at the time of joining. Krishnanagar asks for the PCC from the PCC portal of WB Police (https://pcc.wb.gov.in). Kalimpong: if the number of applicants is much higher

the authority may shortlist on the basis of educational qualification and driving experience. The merit list will be published on the Kalimpong District Police website and displayed outside the unit notice board. Original documents are verified at the time of interview (Kalimpong
Krishnanagar). Murshidabad asks candidates to bring originals when called for the Driving Test or Interview.
how_to_apply: The notices do not provide an online application link. Candidates must submit the prescribed application form (Annexure-I) offline in the drop box of the concerned unit. Kalimpong and Krishnanagar state that the form must be submitted personally and not by post.
Download the application form from wbpolice.gov.in or the website of the concerned unit (Krishnanagar also distributes forms from its Motor Transport Section at Krishnanagar Police Line).
Fill in the form in capital letters and mention your mobile number.
Paste a recent passport-size photograph (4.5 cm x 3.5 cm), self-attested where the form asks for it.
Attach self-attested copies of the supporting documents listed below.
Submit the form in the drop box of the concerned unit before its last date. Where the notice prescribes a superscription for the envelope, write it exactly.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications without the required documents may be rejected (Kalimpong, Krishnanagar, Murshidabad). Murshidabad also states that applications received after the due date may be rejected. Canvassing in any form or bringing any influence is treated as disqualification (Kalimpong, Krishnanagar). No TA/DA is paid for attending the Driving Test and Interview (Kalimpong, Krishnanagar). Furnishing false information or suppressing material facts may lead to rejection or cancellation (Murshidabad). The Annexure-I forms ask whether any criminal case is initiated or pending against the applicant. Hooghly Rural’s form also asks for bank and Aadhaar details, and Murshidabad’s form asks for an alternate number, email ID and left thumb impression with a checklist of enclosures. Contractual service conditions are governed by the contract and applicable Government rules. No claim for regularisation will be entertained. The competent authority may cancel the process at any stage without prior notice and without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: WB Police Driver Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Each unit has notified its own vacancies for the post of Driver (Contractual). Purulia has the most posts (12), followed by Hooghly Rural and Krishnanagar (10 each). Reservation category-wise breakup is not specified in the provided notices. The SAP 8th Battalion notice is a corrigendum. It partially cancels the earlier notice (Memo No. 276/IHQ dated 16.10.2026) and notifies 03 Driver posts. The SAP 13th Battalion notice is a partial modification of its Memo No. 215/IHQ dated 12.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: WB Police Driver Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Driving Test and Interview of 40 marks in total. Shortlisted candidates with valid applications are called for both stages, and a merit list is prepared on the marks obtained. Provisionally selected candidates must undergo a Medical Fitness Test as directed by the competent authority. The selected candidate must submit a Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) at the time of joining. Krishnanagar asks for the PCC from the PCC portal of WB Police (https://pcc.wb.gov.in). Kalimpong: if the number of applicants is much higher, the authority may shortlist on the basis of educational qualification and driving experience. The merit list will be published on the Kalimpong District Police website and displayed outside the unit notice board. Original documents are verified at the time of interview (Kalimpong, Krishnanagar). Murshidabad asks candidates to bring originals when called for the Driving Test or Interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notices do not provide an online application link. Candidates must submit the prescribed application form (Annexure-I) offline in the drop box of the concerned unit. Kalimpong and Krishnanagar state that the form must be submitted personally and not by post. Download the application form from wbpolice.gov.in or the website of the concerned unit (Krishnanagar also distributes forms from its Motor Transport Section at Krishnanagar Police Line). Fill in the form in capital letters and mention your mobile number. Paste a recent passport-size photograph (4.5 cm x 3.5 cm), self-attested where the form asks for it. Attach self-attested copies of the supporting documents listed below. Submit the form in the drop box of the concerned unit before its last date. Where the notice prescribes a superscription for the envelope, write it exactly.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Photocopy of certificate or mark sheet of educational qualification Photocopy of birth certificate or age-proof certificate Photocopy of driving licence Photocopy of document showing residential address (preferably Aadhaar Card) Copy of certificate in respect of working experience Extra-curricular certificate regarding motor repairing and others (optional in the Murshidabad notice) Kalimpong lists self-attested copies of Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card, PAN Card, Driving License, educational certificates and experience certificate. Krishnanagar accepts PAN Card, Driving License, Voter Card or Aadhaar Card as identification and residential proof. The Annexure-I note asks for self-attested copies of documents against Sl. Nos. 3, 4, 6, 7 and 10 of the form.

No TA/DA is paid for attending the Driving Test and Interview (Kalimpong, Krishnanagar). Furnishing false information or suppressing material facts may lead to rejection or cancellation (Murshidabad). The Annexure-I forms ask whether any criminal case is initiated or pending against the applicant. Hooghly Rural’s form also asks for bank and Aadhaar details, and Murshidabad’s form asks for an alternate number, email ID and left thumb impression with a checklist of enclosures. Contractual service conditions are governed by the contract and applicable Government rules. No claim for regularisation will be entertained. The competent authority may cancel the process at any stage without prior notice and without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is conducted by the West Bengal Police (WB Police) for filling up driver positions on a contractual basis in the Dakshin Dinajpur district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 70 vacancies including 4 specific posts for Drivers are announced under this recruitment drive for eligible candidates meeting the job requirements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class VIII from a recognized board along with a valid LMV or HMV driving licence and at least 3 years of driving experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit to apply for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 21 and 40 years of age as on the date of advertisement to be eligible for submission of their offline application forms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Driver position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed for the Driver position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 16,000 per month during their contractual period.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for WB Police Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Interested candidates must download the form, attach required documents, and submit it by hand into the specified drop box.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed offline application form is 5 November 2026, which is approximately 14 days from the date of publication.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted by hand in the drop box located at the Motor Transport Section, Balurghat Police Lines, Dakshin Dinajpur, West Bengal - 733103.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Driving Test carrying 20 marks, an Interview carrying 20 marks, and a final Medical Fitness Test for qualifying candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to the West Bengal Police Driver recruitment positions.
